title: F.22 — Schema verification + rollback test (full forward+down+forward)
description: Full S1 verification gate. Run all S1 migrations forward, capture db/schema.rb diff, run db:rollback STEP=22 to reverse all, run db:migrate again to re-apply. Confirm bin/ci passes after each forward run. Per S1 §G dry-run procedure.
design: Procedure: bin/rails db:reset && bin/rails db:migrate && cp db/schema.rb /tmp/schema-after.rb && bin/rails db:rollback STEP=22 && bin/rails db:migrate && diff db/schema.rb /tmp/schema-after.rb (should match) && bin/ci.
acceptance_criteria: Forward migration clean; rollback clean; re-apply matches; bin/ci passes; final schema diff committed alongside the migration files.

title: F.20 — Widen cards.id PK from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P9 §A.2: the keystone migration. cards.id becomes Beads issue id (string). Must run AFTER all child FK columns are widened (F.8-F.19) so PK type matches FK type at re-add time (F.21).
design: Migration: WidenCardsIdPk. change_column :cards, :id, :string, limit: 255, null: false; ensure PK constraint is preserved. Re-create any indexes that depend on id type. Down: change back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; cards.id is varchar(255) PK; all child FK columns are compatible (already widened F.8-F.19); rollback works in clean install.

title: F.18b — Widen storage_entries.recordable_id polymorphic from uuid to varchar 255 - missed in S1 v1
description: Per P1 sec A.9 + Gemini S1 review catch: storage_entries is the audit log of storage mutations with polymorphic recordable_type/recordable_id pairs. Card is one of the recordable types per Card.image attachment audit trail. This FK must widen to varchar 255 to accommodate Beads-id-format Card mirror rows.
design: Migration: WidenStorageEntriesRecordableId. change_column :storage_entries, :recordable_id, :string, limit: 255, null: true. Index on recordable_type+recordable_id is preserved. Down: change back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; storage_entries.recordable_id is varchar 255 nullable; index intact; rollback works in clean install.

title: F.21 — Re-add FK constraints with new varchar(255) types
description: Re-create the FK constraints that F.7 dropped, now with both sides varchar(255). Ensures ongoing referential integrity.
design: Migration: ReAddCardFkConstraints. For each remaining child table (assignments, comments, steps, pins, watches, notifications), add_foreign_key :child_table, :cards. Down: remove_foreign_key.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; FK constraints exist on all retained child tables; rollback removes them.

title: F.18 — Widen active_storage_attachments.record_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + Q-S-025: ActiveStorage attachment polymorphic to Card.image, Identity.avatar, Account::Import.file. record_id widens.
design: Migration: WidenActiveStorageRecordId. change_column :active_storage_attachments, :record_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.17 — Widen action_text_rich_texts.record_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + Q-S-012: rich text polymorphic to Card/Comment/Board. record_id widens to accommodate Beads-id-format Card mirror rows.
design: Migration: WidenActionTextRecordId. change_column :action_text_rich_texts, :record_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.19 — Widen search_records_0..15 (16 shards) searchable_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P9 §A.2: 16-shard FTS table; searchable_id polymorphic to Card/Comment. All 16 shards widen in one migration.
design: Migration: WidenSearchRecordsSearchableId. Iterate 0..15: change_column "search_records_#{i}".to_sym, :searchable_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: iterate back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; all 16 shards have searchable_id varchar(255); rollback works.

title: F.16 — Widen reactions.reactable_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P1 §C.5: reactions polymorphic to Card or Comment. reactable_id widens.
design: Migration: WidenReactionsReactableId. change_column :reactions, :reactable_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.15 — Widen mentions.source_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P1 §C.5: mentions polymorphic to Card or Comment. source_id widens.
design: Migration: WidenMentionsSourceId. change_column :mentions, :source_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.13 — Widen notifications.card_id + notifications.source_id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E: notifications Fizzy-only inbox aggregate; both card_id (FK) AND source_id (polymorphic to Event/Mention) widen.
design: Migration: WidenNotificationsIds. change_column :notifications, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false; change_column :notifications, :source_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.14 — Widen events.eventable_id (polymorphic) from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P8: events table is polymorphic; eventable_id holds ids for Card AND non-Card eventables (Comment, Step, etc.). Widening lets it accommodate both Beads issue ids (string) and existing UUIDs.
design: Migration: WidenEventsEventableId. change_column :events, :eventable_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. No FK constraint to drop (polymorphic). Down: change back (will fail if any string-format ids exist; rollback is for pre-deploy scenarios per S1 §D).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works in clean install.

title: F.11 — Widen pins.card_id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E: pins (per-user favorite) Fizzy-only sidecar; FK type widens.
design: Migration: WidenPinsCardId. change_column :pins, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.12 — Widen watches.card_id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E: watches (per-user notification subscription) Fizzy-only sidecar; FK type widens.
design: Migration: WidenWatchesCardId. change_column :watches, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.10 — Widen steps.card_id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E: steps survives in V1 per Q-S-020 deferred-decision. card_id FK type widens.
design: Migration: WidenStepsCardId. change_column :steps, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Down: change back.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; rollback works.

title: F.9 — Widen comments.card_id AND comments.id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P9 §C.2: comments are mirrored from Beads. Both the FK to cards AND the comment id itself become varchar(255) (mirror id = beads comment id).
design: Migration: WidenCommentsIds. change_column :comments, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false; change_column :comments, :id, :string, limit: 255, null: false (PK); drop+recreate any indexes that depend on column type. Down: change back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; comments.id and comments.card_id are varchar(255); indexes intact; rollback works.

title: F.8 — Widen assignments.card_id from uuid to varchar(255)
description: Per P3 §E + P7 §A.2: assignments sidecar survives; card_id FK column type changes to accommodate Beads issue ids (fizzy-<suffix>).
design: Migration: WidenAssignmentsCardId. change_column :assignments, :card_id, :string, limit: 255, null: false. Drop+recreate (assignee_id, card_id) unique index. Down: change back to :uuid.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; assignments.card_id is varchar(255) NOT NULL; unique index intact; rollback works.

title: F.6 — Drop taggings table (P7 §B.2 Beads labels = source of truth)
description: Per P7 §B.2: taggings join is dropped; Beads labels table owns issue↔label association. Fizzy Tag model survives for normalization+display, but the join goes through Beads via the poller.
design: Migration: DropTaggings. drop_table :taggings. Down: recreate per db/schema.rb.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; taggings absent; rollback recreates; Tagging model removal handled in I-S1.

title: F.7 — Drop FK constraints from remaining child tables before widening
description: Before widening cards.id PK + child FK columns from uuid to varchar(255), drop the FK constraints so the type change does not violate referential integrity.
design: Migration: DropCardFkConstraints. For each remaining child table (assignments, comments, steps, pins, watches, notifications), remove_foreign_key :child_table, :cards. Down: re-add (they will be re-added in F.21 with new types anyway).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; no FK constraints remaining on cards.id from any child table; subsequent F.8-F.20 can run safely.

title: F.5 — Drop closures table (P6 §B Beads status=closed + events.actor)
description: Per P6 §B: close = Beads status transition (issues.status=closed); attribution from issues.closed_at + events.actor for last close-related event. Fizzy closures cache table is redundant.
design: Migration: DropClosures. drop_table :closures. Down: recreate per db/schema.rb (uuid id, account_id, card_id unique, user_id, timestamps).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; closures table absent; rollback recreates; Closure model removal handled in I-S1.

title: F.4 — Drop card_not_nows table (P6 §C status=deferred replaces NotNow)
description: Per P6 §C: NotNow becomes Beads issues.status=deferred (+ optional defer_until). Postpone-by-user audit available via Beads events.actor. Fizzy card_not_nows table is redundant.
design: Migration: DropCardNotNows. drop_table :card_not_nows. Down: recreate per db/schema.rb.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; table absent; rollback recreates; no AR errors after Card::NotNow model removal in I-S1.

title: F.3 — Drop card_activity_spikes table (P6 §F compute stalled from timestamps)
description: Per P6 §F: drop persisted ActivitySpike row; compute "stalled" from issues.updated_at (default N=14 days). Table card_activity_spikes is unused in the fork.
design: Migration: DropCardActivitySpikes. drop_table :card_activity_spikes. Down: recreate per db/schema.rb.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; table absent from schema; rollback recreates; no AR errors after Card::ActivitySpike model removal in I-S1.

title: F.2 — Drop card_goldnesses table (P4 §G priority replaces goldness)
description: Per P4 §G: drop goldness as a stored lifecycle component; render derived from issues.priority=0. Table card_goldnesses is unused in the fork. Migration drops it cleanly.
design: Migration: DropCardGoldnesses. drop_table :card_goldnesses. Down: recreate with original columns (uuid id, account_id, card_id, created_at, updated_at, indexes per db/schema.rb).
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate succeeds; table absent from db/schema.rb post-migrate; rollback recreates table; no AR errors (Card::Goldness model can be removed in I-S1 implementation, separate concern).

title: F.1 — Add cards.beads_status column (additive, runs first)
description: Per P9 §A.2 and S1 §F: add cards.beads_status varchar(32) + index. Mirror of Beads issues.status (open/in_progress/blocked/deferred/closed). Card.status enum {drafted, published} stays unchanged. This is the first migration in the S1 chain because it is purely additive and has no dependencies on later FK changes.
design: Migration: AddBeadsStatusToCards. add_column :cards, :beads_status, :string, limit: 32; add_index :cards, :beads_status. Down: drop the column + index.
acceptance_criteria: bin/rails db:migrate runs clean; db/schema.rb shows new column + index; bin/rails db:rollback removes them; bin/rails db:migrate re-applies; bin/ci passes; no AR errors at boot.
